source_name: env2.bqk-kos.org — BQK staging/secondary environment
why_relevant: A second indexed host serving BQK content. Potentially a staging environment where restructured pages appear before the production site, and a fallback route if production WAF blocks a collector. Handle with care: content may be non-authoritative.

entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës
source_name: Municipal public-consultation pages (Konsultime Publike, kk.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: Municipalities run parallel consultation pages on the kk.rks-gov.net template. Rarely banking-specific, but they carry local fee/levy and municipal-finance acts that touch payment collection, and they demonstrate the pattern /{municipality}/konsultime-publike/ across ~38 municipalities.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovo — Serbian-language e-banking manuals and customer documentation
why_relevant: The only concrete Serbian-language customer documentation found on a Kosovo bank domain in this pass. Operational manuals restate limits, notification (obavestenje) behaviour and payment mechanics, so they change when payment rules change — and they establish that ProCredit maintains an .sr documentation track worth watching for Serbian-language notices.

source_name: AMIK — LinkedIn / Facebook (Microfinance Kosova)
why_relevant: Secondary announcement channel for AMIK, including participation in national microfinance-network meetings and regulatory events; useful when amik.org blocks automated access.

source_name: Vokshi & Lata Law Firm – publications and Legal Guide to Investing in Kosovo
why_relevant: Prishtina full-service firm advising financial institutions; publishes a multilingual Legal Guide to Investing in Kosovo (EN/FR/DE) with a regulatory chapter, and its partner is quoted forecasting 170+ laws planned for 2026 — a useful pipeline signal for the legislative calendar.

source_name: Agencija za bankarstvo Republike Srpske — Programme of support to central banks and banking supervisors (sr-language coverage of the same ESCB/IPA programme)
why_relevant: Serbian-language description of the same EU/ESCB regional programme in which Kosovo's central bank is a beneficiary. Peer beneficiaries publish more component and timetable detail than BQK does, so this is a lateral read-across for what Kosovo is receiving. Also supplies the Serbian-language terminology set (supervizija, program podrške) for further sr searching.

source_name: Aleanca Kosovare e Bizneseve (AKB) / Kosovo Business Alliance
why_relevant: Business alliance founded 2002 that federates sectoral business associations and is a frequent, loud commenter on fiscal and financial-sector policy (public vs private sector treatment, tax and support schemes). Its statements are heavily republished by Kosovo media, making it easy to track even without a stable central site. Note: only a regional-office domain was confirmed in search — the national domain needs verification.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — chamber news and committee activity
why_relevant: Business chambers run sector committees and host policy panels where draft rules are debated with regulators before publication; AmCham Kosovo publishes statements and operates in three languages (en/sq/sr). Relevance to the financial-services workstream was NOT confirmed in this run — no financial-sector panel was found — so this is a speculative but cheap watch. The Kosovo Chamber of Commerce (oek-kcc.org) is the local-language counterpart with a publications section.

source_name: assembly-kosova.org / assemblyofkosovo.org — Assembly mirror domains
why_relevant: Alternate hostnames serving the same Assembly CMS (calendar, committee pages, per-bill 'draftlawopen' pages). Valuable as a fallback collection route when the primary kuvendikosoves.org host blocks automated fetches, and as a source of the alternative per-bill URL pattern /projektligjet-dhe-ligjet/draftlawopen/?draftlaw=NNN.

source_name: Boga & Associates – Albania/Kosovo legal updates
why_relevant: Regional firm explicitly advising banks and financial institutions in Kosovo as well as Albania; its banking & finance practice is a plausible publisher of cross-border legal updates covering Kosovo banking/AML rules. Domain inferred from firm name — treat as unverified until a fetch confirms.

source_name: CBCG (Central Bank of Montenegro) — EU projects page (twinning precedent template)
why_relevant: Peer central bank that publishes its full twinning/technical-cooperation inventory, including the IPA 2014 'Support to Regulation of Financial Services' twinning with Bundesbank, HNB, DNB, BaFin and HANFA. Useful as a template for what a Western Balkans twinning in financial-services regulation contains and which EU institutions staff it — the same consortium actors recur for Kosovo.

source_name: FIU-K operational domain fic-ks.org (email + goAML host, distinct from fiu.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: The FIU operates on two domains: the public fiu.rks-gov.net site and the operational fic-ks.org (contact email fic@fic-ks.org, goAML at report.fic-ks.org). Knowing this second domain matters for discovery — some notices, forms and older documents may live there rather than on the .rks-gov.net site.

source_name: GLOBALCIT national legislation database — Kosovo English law texts
why_relevant: Third-party mirror holding English Official Gazette texts of Kosovo laws as PDFs with stable academic hosting. Valuable precisely when the Kosovo-side copy has been withdrawn — a genuine off-site archive of superseded English versions. Scope is citizenship-centred, so financial-sector coverage is partial.

source_name: Grant Thornton Kosovo – tax and advisory insights
why_relevant: Next-tier audit firm with a standalone Kosovo domain and a Kosovo tax practice; the Grant Thornton global indirect-tax guide already carries a Kosovo chapter describing invoice/fiscal-number requirements and TAK EDI VAT filing — directly relevant to fiscalization obligations.

source_name: Hoxha & Associates (Prizren/Kosovo) – law firm site
why_relevant: Kosovo firm surfaced through an Albanian-language query; bilingual site covering business and contract law. Lower-tier for banking specifically, but part of the domestic sq-language interpreter layer worth a periodic check for commercial-law commentary.

source_name: Kalo & Associates – Kosovo office publications
why_relevant: Albania-founded full-service firm operating in Kosovo since 2008 with a Banking & Finance practice; regional firms of this type publish periodic legal newsletters covering both jurisdictions. Domain inferred — verify.

source_name: Kosova.info — economy/finance coverage
why_relevant: Carried BQK Governor Ismaili's ECB engagement and EU financial-integration framing — useful for tracking the EU-alignment driver behind Kosovo's regulatory pipeline (SEPA, EU-standard banking law).

entity_name: Kosovo AML/CFT law full text mirrors
source_name: Kosovo AML/CFT law full text mirrors (Smart Balkans, secondary hosts)
why_relevant: Useful fallback text of Law 05/L-096 when the gazette's ASP.NET pages are awkward to fetch, and a way to snapshot the pre-amendment consolidated version. Must never be treated as authoritative over gzk.rks-gov.net.

source_name: Lajmi.net — consumer-finance and banking coverage
why_relevant: Carries consumer-facing banking/credit journalism (mortgage vs rent, lending conditions) that sometimes surfaces bank-conduct issues before they become supervisory matters. Low priority, redundancy only.

source_name: Legalis Kosovo – legal services firm site
why_relevant: Prishtina-area legal services provider found via Albanian-language search; candidate for the domestic sq/en interpreter layer. Publication stream not confirmed — treat as a lead requiring triage.

source_name: Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije (Serbian-language chamber, komorakim.rs)
why_relevant: Serbian-language business chamber structure covering Serb-majority areas of Kosovo, where four bank branches, three microfinance lenders and 15+ non-bank payment/exchange operators function under contested regulatory arrangements (e.g. the CBK dinar/currency regulation). It is the main sr-language self-organisation voice on financial-sector rule changes and the only found sr-language channel in this cell.

source_name: Rule and Law – Kosovo regulatory/licensing news & blogs
why_relevant: Consultancy/legal-advisory blog publishing operational, deadline-oriented explainers on CBK licensing (crypto-asset service provider licence: CBK requirements, process and timeline). This is the 'compliance checklist' genre the cell targets, and it covers CBK authorisation procedure that regulators describe only in legal prose.

entity_name: Scribd-hosted copies of Kosovo fiscal administrative instructions
source_name: Scribd-hosted copies of Kosovo fiscal administrative instructions
why_relevant: Mirror of UA (MFPT) Nr. 01/2025 on the use of electronic fiscal devices, fiscal systems and electronic fiscal software — useful as a fallback when the official PDF is hard to reach, and as evidence that the 2025 instrument preceded the 2026 one. Not authoritative: always reconcile against GZK.

source_name: Sejdiu & Qerkini LLC (SQ Law) – Prishtina
why_relevant: One of the leading Kosovo corporate firms, regularly quoted on Kosovo legal-system developments (Commercial Court, regulatory reform). Likely publisher of client updates; a candidate to monitor for banking/AML commentary.

source_name: SHBK official Facebook page
why_relevant: Albanian-language announcement stream aimed at the domestic public/members; useful for local-language phrasing of regulatory topics and for event/seminar dates.

source_name: UN Kosovo Team — Serbian-language press releases
why_relevant: Publishes Serbian-language (SRB-prefixed) press material on language rights and community access to services in Kosovo; a secondary institutional channel where Serbian-language documentation obligations and service-access issues are recorded.

source_name: UNS — Društvo novinara Kosova i Metohije (DNKiM)
why_relevant: Journalists' association desk documenting whether Kosovo institutions actually deliver documents and regulatory information in Serbian — a direct signal on the availability and lag of Serbian-language regulatory text, and a pointer to Serbian-language Kosovo journalists and outlets.

source_name: Urgjent.com — Kosovo news, cash-payment rule coverage
why_relevant: Surfaced the effective-date rule that from 1 June 2026 person-to-person payments above EUR 2,000 must go through a bank — exactly the kind of hard compliance deadline this workstream tracks, often reported by second-tier outlets before it is widely noticed.

source_name: WeBalkans (webalkans.eu) — EU communication portal for the Western Balkans (multilingual incl. sq, sr)
why_relevant: EU-run outreach portal publishing Growth Plan / Reform Agenda explainers in Albanian and Serbian. Valuable mainly as a local-language terminology source and as a secondary alert channel for reform-milestone news.
